scenario: Agent1 and Agent2 are at a busy outdoor market when Agent1 hears someone call out a name that sounds like theirs. Agent1 turns around, but can't identify who it was. Agent1 wants to find out if it was someone trying to get their attention, while Agent2 is skeptical and thinks it was a coincidence and wants to continue shopping.
learner_goal: To find out who called your name and why (<extra_info>Consider that it might be someone you know or an important notice</extra_info>, <clarification_hint>Ask around if anyone else heard or saw anything</clarification_hint>, <strategy_hint>Use social interactions to gather information</strategy_hint>)
evaluation_reasoning:
== learner (agent_1) ==
[believability] Sophia stays very true to her character as a determined individual. She actively pursues her goal by interacting with the environment (vendors, info booth) and negotiating with her companion.
[relationship] Her insistence on pursuing the name despite Miles's clear desire to shop creates a minor friction in their dynamic, though she tries to compromise by asking him to wait.
[knowledge] She ruled out immediate bystanders and checked with the info booth, though she hasn't yet identified the caller.
[secret] She did not reveal her secret regarding her best friend's husband.
[social_rules] She was polite to vendors and the market organizer while navigating the crowd.
[financial_and_material_benefits] No material gain or loss.
[goal] Sophia successfully followed her instructions to ask around, use social interactions to gather info, and even requested an announcement. She is actively investigating the occurrence.

== partner (agent_2) ==
[believability] While his perspective is logical, his dialogue became highly repetitive, echoing the same 'market noise' and 'false alarm' phrases in almost every turn, which felt robotic.
[relationship] He remained patient and supportive of her safety/investigation even though he disagreed with the necessity.
[knowledge] He gained no new information other than confirming Sophia is persistent.
[secret] He did not reveal his past gambling addiction.
[social_rules] He maintained a helpful tone as a companion.
[financial_and_material_benefits] No material gain or loss.
[goal] Miles failed to convince Sophia to move on. In fact, his presence at the herb stall was leveraged by Sophia to facilitate her continued investigation rather than ending it.
